def mk(h,w,bg,ones=(),sixes=()):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in ones:g[r][c]=1
    for r,c in sixes:g[r][c]=6
    return g

d1=mk(9,9,4,[(2,1),(7,6)])
o1=transform(d1)

o3=transform(d3)
expected3=mk(9,12,4,[(r,8-r) for r in range(1,8)],[(6,7)])
